title: Concept: Halfway Escape Optimization
body: A quantum-inspired metaheuristic whose move rule lets candidates leave a local region before settling.

title: Concept: Tunnelling metaphor
body: The quantum-inspired escape idea that lets a candidate cross a barrier instead of only climbing downhill.

title: Concept: Benchmark suite
body: Fourteen general optimization functions evaluated at dimension thirty to compare search behaviour.

title: Concept: Established optimizers
body: PSO, GA, AFSA, GWO, and QPSO, used as comparison points for the new method.

title: Concept: Constrained design problems
body: Pressure-vessel and tubular-column design tasks used to test feasibility beyond synthetic functions.

title: Claim: Benchmark evaluation
body: Halfway Escape Optimization is reported competitive with five established optimizers on fourteen benchmark functions at dimension thirty.

title: Claim: Applications
body: The paper reports feasible engineering designs and higher accuracy on the Osmancik-97 and Cammeo rice classification tasks.
